decision.rationale: I checked the time limit first. TXN-008153 on CRD-000091 posted on 2026-09-04, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-26. That is 52 days, inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. The posted amount is 34608 minor units, and authorisation AUTH-008338 was approved for the same 34608 minor units, so the two amounts match. No receipt or quote is attached. The cardholder says the quote was 304.56 EUR, a difference of 4152 minor units, but also says they do not have the quote, so that figure is a claim and not a receipt. Under amount-no-receipt, when there is no receipt and the posted amount equals the authorised amount, nothing in the records shows a different agreed amount. The next step is to ask Brightwater Devices (MER-000050) for the receipt or order details. No credit is proposed until that evidence is reviewed.

proposed_actions.note: Please provide the receipt, quote or order details for the purchase of 346.08 EUR on 2026-09-03. They should show the amount the customer agreed to pay.
